text:
Iris Lin: quick one  for the Service Metrics panel: where should units live? inline in the legend (e.g., "Latency (ms)") or on the y-axis label? also debating whether to auto-smooth series by default or keep raw and let users toggle smoothing.
Diego Morales: inline in the legend is more scannable when you have multiple metrics stacked. axis label is fine for single-metric charts.
Priya Nair: +1 legend inline. accessibility note: screen readers should announce the unit after the metric name: "Errors per second, per second" feels awkward though. maybe map common units to clearer phrases.
Noah K.: smoothing: default should be raw. smoothing can mask regressions. add an obvious toggle: "Smoothing: Off / 7-point" with small info tooltip explaining what it does.
Iris Lin: good point about regressions. UX idea: default raw with a subtle "Enable smoothing" CTA in the chart header when series is noisy.
Diego Morales: outliers: two options we've considered: 1) clip y-axis and show caret with tooltip "value outside range"; 2) show full value but scale the chart, which compresses everything else. Prefer 1 with an affordance to expand/zoom into range.
Priya Nair: if we clip, badge must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-label like: "Spike off-chart: 123,456 requests". sample snippet: ```<button aria-label="Spike off-chart: 123,456 requests" class="chart-spike">Expand</button>```
Noah K.: CSV export requirement: always export raw numeric values and include a units column. e.g., CSV headers: Metric,Timestamp,Value,Unit.
Iris Lin: legend truncation: long metric names cause wrap. proposal: show short name + tooltip with full name and unit. copy: short name first, then muted unit: "p95 latency  \u2014 ms".
Diego Morales: microcopy for smoothing tooltip: "Smoothing reduces short-term variance by averaging adjacent points. Use for trend exploration; disable to inspect raw samples." keep it <140 chars.
Priya Nair: also add a11y hint: when smoothing toggles, notify screen readers with aria-live: "Smoothing on: values are averaged". design-bot: accessibility checklist: ensure focus order includes legend items, smoothing toggle keyboard accessible, outlier badge focusable, provide aria-live updates for toggles and zoom actions.
Noah K.: dev note: we should expose smoothing window size in query params so URLs capture view state. also expose ?format=csv to download.
Iris Lin: final copy proposals: legend unit placement: "Inline (recommended)" and axis label fallback: "Show unit on axis if single metric"; smoothing toggle label: "Smoothing: Off / On (7-point)"; outlier affordance label: "Expand spike" button with aria "Expand spike at 2026-03-01: 123,456".
Diego Morales: looks good. I'll mock variants with inline units + axis unit header and a clip+expand flow for spikes. posting PNG in ~45m.
Priya Nair: tiny nit: color contrast for muted unit text should be >= 4.5:1 when used for critical units.
Iris Lin: thanks team. will update the component spec and ping eng. :rocket:
